summary:
With more than 7 years’ experience working as an Android developer and a little time as a Team leader (I Working 6 years in Tinh Van Outsourcing and onsite many the company: Panasonic, NCB, Savvycom, Haveynas). I have gained a certain professionalism level as a Senior android developer or begin as a Team leader with skill: 
• Manage team member and the project. 
• Skill and experience for develop logistic system, banking system. 
• Proficient with Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Studio, Gradle, SVN, GIT, Redmine, Jira, Trello. 
• Skill and experience in software design (System Structure Design, Program Structure Design). 
• Be able to analysis, design, develop, test and deploy Android app from the ground up, build base project, library. 
• Skill and experience in improve performance. 
• Skill and experience in multi-threading and asynchronous programming. 
• Skill and experience in analysis and problem solving. 
• Skill and experience using android, RX java, data binding, third party. 
• Skill and experience using MVP, MVC and MVVM. 
• Skill and experience about application life cycle, basic UI elements & layout, basic animation technique, auto-layout. 
• Skill and experience for multiscreen, Restful api (json, xml), Activity, Fragment, Service, Broadcast receiver, SQLite, design layout xml, json, xml, google maps, firebase… 
• Skill and experience about application: play video, music, Websocket, WebRT, chat OTT, social (facebook, twitter). 
• Able to work independently and in a team, with high responsibility.
